title: Annotatio V §.X reply (1): Indignorum gravity deferred to next Annotatio
pass_a_gloss: To which I reply to the first: Concerning the gravity and lightness of the error, as it pertains to Eating of the Unworthy, we shall examine in the Annotatio next following.
pass_b_english: Reply to the first: how heavy or light the Indignorum error is belongs in the Annotatio that follows next.
This locus therefore does not settle that gravity question here.
source_text: Cui respondeo ad prius: De gravitate ac levitate erroris, quod ad Indignorum Manducationem attinet, dispiciemus Annotat. proximè sequenti.

lemmas.gloss: gravity and lightness of the error
